dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ms. Gendou, you seem to be in a good mood today.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Hmm? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't seem like your usual self...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Oh? You think so? I'll take note of it.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Maybe I'm just in a great mood today... I mean, I just drew a "Great Fortune" slip and all! Just wanted to pay it forward, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Still, what some call "Great Fortune" might be "Great Misfortune" for others.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: For those who receive "great misfortune"... I wonder, what awaits them at the Fortune Slip Hanger?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Ah, fortunes are so very interesting! See you later.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hands over the fortune slip) In the middle of a hazy night.
